kpis.description_fr: Croissance SSS FY24. KPI #1 retail. Surperforme catégorie sporting goods. Stratégie premium + experiential (House of Sport).
kpis.description_en: FY24 SSS growth. Retail #1 KPI. Outperforms sporting goods category. Premium + experiential strategy (House of Sport).

kpis.description_fr: Stores House of Sport (mega-store experiential) FY24. Format vedette : rock climbing wall, batting cages, basketball court, golf simulator. Ouvre nouveau TAM premium.
kpis.description_en: FY24 House of Sport stores (mega-store experiential). Flagship format: rock climbing wall, batting cages, basketball court, golf simulator. Opens premium TAM.

kpis.description_fr: Ticket moyen FY24. Mix premium (Nike, Lululemon, On Running, Hoka). Pricing power maintained.
kpis.description_en: FY24 avg ticket. Premium mix (Nike, Lululemon, On Running, Hoka). Pricing power maintained.

kpis.description_fr: Part ecommerce FY24 (vs ~10% pre-COVID). 95% domestic, BOPIS strong. Plateforme tech maison.
kpis.description_en: FY24 ecommerce share (vs ~10% pre-COVID). 95% domestic, BOPIS strong. In-house tech platform.

kpis_story.description_fr: Mai 2025 annonce acquisition Foot Locker pour $2.4Md ($24/sh). Combine #1 sporting goods (DKS) + #1 athletic specialty (FL). Ajoute 2400 stores internationaux. Closing prévu H2 2025.
kpis_story.description_en: May 2025 Foot Locker $2.4Bn acquisition announcement ($24/sh). Combines #1 sporting goods (DKS) + #1 athletic specialty (FL). Adds 2400 international stores. H2 2025 closing.

_notes: Largest US sporting goods retailer. Source: 10-K FY24 filed Mar 2025.
